Good! Now I understand the schema. Let me find a recent pending order (where ShippedDate IS NULL) and join it with customer information.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 
  o.OrderID,
  o.OrderDate,
  o.RequiredDate,
  c.CompanyName,
  c.ContactName,
  c.Country,
  o.Freight,
  o.ShipAddress
FROM Orders o
JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NULL
LIMIT 1

payload.content: I'll query the Order Details for order 11008 and join with Products to check inventory levels.

SELECT 
  p.ProductID,
  p.ProductName,
  od.Quantity AS QuantityOrdered,
  p.UnitsInStock,
  CASE 
    WHEN p.UnitsInStock >= od.Quantity THEN 'YES'
    ELSE 'NO'
  END AS StockSufficient
FROM [Order Details] od
JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE od.OrderID = 11008
ORDER BY p.ProductID
